answer: PUF-anchored channel attestation: each agent must answer a fresh challenge with the noisy challenge-response of an embedded physical unclonable function—e.g., laser speckle from a molded walnut-resin tag or a pearl-layer scatterer—whose nanoscale disorder is unique and unclonable. A fuzzy extractor stabilizes responses across tundra-like temperature drift. Sybils need one enrolled physical token per identity; an operator cannot synthesize extra valid responses, and must bear fabrication, enrollment, distribution, and online-maintenance costs for each.
